thread.title: Apple Music Coming To Amazon Echo Smart Speakers | Investor's Business Daily

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Apple Music Coming To Amazon Echo Smart Speakers | Investor's Business Daily
text:
Amazon.com ( AMZN ) announced Friday that Apple Music subscribers will soon be able to play the service through Amazon Echo smart speakers. The deal illustrates the improving relationship between the two tech giants, who often compete with each other.
X Apple 's ( AAPL ) streaming music service will be available on Echo devices starting the week of Dec. 17, Amazon said in a blog post .
Owners of Echo speakers will be able to make Apple Music song and artist requests using their voice. For instance, they could say, "Alexa, play Bebe Rexha on Apple Music." Alexa is the voice-activated personal assistant technology in Echo speakers.
"Music is one of the most popular features on Alexa," Dave Limp, senior vice president, Amazon Devices, said in a statement. "Since we launched Alexa four years ago, customers are listening to more music in their homes than ever before."

Please contact customer service CLOSE Amazon Opening Echo Speakers To More Music Services Last month, Amazon launched a "music skill" application program interface for developers. That has allowed Alexa to offer more third-party music services. Amazon has its own streaming music service called Amazon Music Unlimited. It also offers a limited service for Prime members called Prime Music.
Last week, Pandora Media ( P ) launched its Pandora Premium streaming music service on Amazon Echo speakers.
Earlier this month, Amazon signed a deal with Apple to offer an expanded selection of Apple products on its e-commerce sites worldwide. The deal covers iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Mac products. One product Amazon will not sell is Apple's HomePod smart speaker, which competes with Amazon's Echo devices.
Amazon and Apple also compete in tablet computers and streaming video devices.
Apple stock fell 0.5% to 178.58 on the stock market today . Amazon rose 1% to 1,690.17.
